app.title: SWAGcleaner
app.subtitle: Tidy up your PC — locally, safely

advisor.title: System Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Reads the system and suggests a plan
advisor.scan_hint: Reads installed apps, processes, services, and startup items

cleaner.title: Cleaner
cleaner.scan_hint: Looks for temp files, caches, and junk
cleaner.choose_hint: After the scan, tick the categories — only the selected ones get deleted.

dedup.title: Photo Duplicates
dedup.subtitle: Finds duplicate and visually similar photos
dedup.folder_hint: Pick a folder to scan images inside
dedup.scan_hint: Uses exact hashes and perceptual hash (imagehash)

tweaks.title: Tweaks
tweaks.subtitle: Startup items and services — we read, we show, we change only with your word
tweaks.empty_backups: Nothing to roll back: no snapshots yet.
tweaks.status_hint: I'll read startup and services — without changing a thing.
tweaks.confirm_disable_note: The entry leaves startup; a snapshot is saved — bring it back with «Restore».
tweaks.confirm_restore_note: The entry returns to startup as it was.
tweaks.services_hint: Services are read-only for now — disabling with a snapshot arrives next round.

journal.title: Deletion journal
journal.cancelled: Cancelled — only part of it was removed.
journal.hint: Scan again — let's see what grew back.

confirm.title: Here is exactly what will be done
confirm.note: Check the list: the action starts only after your «yes».

lines.hello: Hi! I'm Clini. I'll show you what's going on with this machine and clean up — with almost no questions asked.
lines.advisor: Taking a look around. The advisor reads the system and offers a plan, and I'll point out anything that smells off.
lines.cleaner: Garbage is my element. Temp files and caches go to the Recycle Bin, not into nowhere.
lines.dedup: Photo duplicates mean the same picture in three copies. I'll find them and keep one.
lines.tweaks: Startup and services — easy there: I don't switch anything off without your word.
lines.settings: Theme, language, font — here we can take a breath. Phew.
lines.scan: Going down the list: programs, services, startup items…
lines.clean: Found some mess. Have a look at the list — I touch nothing without you.
lines.calm: Phew. Almost clean in here — but no slacking, there is still work to do.
lines.cancelled: Fine, I'm touching nothing. Say the word and we'll get back to it.
lines.panic: Will you look at all this! One bucket won't do the job — we need a plan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.font_note: The pixel font is a matter of taste — one click switches back to default.
settings.sounds_note: Short blips on clicks, section changes and finished work.
settings.backup_info: Backups are stored locally and kept only for rollback.
settings.ollama_note: Later — local advisor with Ollama. Not active yet.

session.purge_plan: Dry run: {count} items, {size} would be removed
session.scan_cancelled: Scan stopped: showing what was covered
session.nothing_to_clean: Scan first to find what to clean.
session.need_rescan: Too many items for one deletion — rescan and narrow the choice by categories.
session.dup_keep_note: The newest copy of each group is kept.
session.purge_real: Will delete {count} items, {size}. Lanes are decided by the core: some to the Recycle Bin, some permanently.
